description: The request AIMClient.verifyAction sends for this action, signed with the RFC 8032 test 1 key. AIMClient.sdk-routes.test.ts requires the client to send exactly this body; the backend's sdk_typescript_request_contract_test.go posts it to the verification handler, which must accept the signature.

context.zeta: last in byte order among the ASCII names
context.Zeta: an upper-case name sorts before every lower-case one
context.: a private-use name: before the next name in UTF-8 byte order, after it in UTF-16
context.😀: a name outside the Basic Multilingual Plane
